goals: build a verified Ceph LXD client package
push package to all LXD cluster members
install into host and snap LXD Ceph paths
create pinned LXD instance only after gates
invariants: ceph.client.lxd.keyring must exist and be non-empty
remote install uses package path, not missing /tmp assumptions
OK must not print after rbd failure
target host must pass rbd gate before LXD create

fallback.no_ceph: create local dir pool and launch instance with local storage
